examples.description: Convert a quote into its invoice

failure_modes.recovery: Call quote_list and retry with an id from the list.
failure_modes.when: id does not name a quote in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Already converted: read converted_invoice_id from the error and run its next_call (invoice_read) — never convert again. Declined: call quote_update with status 'sent' or 'accepted' first, then convert. Changed while converting: nothing was converted; run next_call (quote_read), check the lines, then call quote_convert again.
failure_modes.when: the quote is already converted, or is declined (declined quotes never convert directly), or the quote or its lines changed while it was converting (lines_changed true, or current_updated_at)

preconditions: ONE call converts the whole quote: claims status, creates the invoice, copies every line item, records converted_invoice_id — nothing else to do afterward.

description: Converts a quote into its invoice in ONE call: claims the quote's 'converted' status first (so a lost race never creates an orphan invoice), copies every live line item across, and records converted_invoice_id — nothing else to do afterward. Refuses if the quote is already converted (the error carries converted_invoice_id) or declined (revive it with quote_update first), and refuses with nothing converted when the quote or its lines changed while it was converting (for example a quote_item call running at the same time): read the quote again with quote_read, then convert. NEXT: invoice_read on the new invoice.
name: quote_convert
